title: Button variant contrast audit and interruptible loading UX
creator: Asha Menon
description: Audit and update button variant token usage and introduce an interruptible loading UX pattern for long-running actions. Reduce visual jitter across density modes, ensure icon-only hit targets meet updated a11y hitbox rules, and create a deterministic fallback for theme-contrast mismatches on older tokens.
acceptance_criteria: All primary/secondary/ghost/destructive variants meet WCAG AA contrast (4.5:1) at normal and compact density with current token set or provide documented override tokens
Loading state is cancellable for user-initiated actions: visible cancel affordance, accessible via keyboard (Esc) and announced via aria-live region
Icon-only buttons have a minimum 44px touch target and a clear visual focus ring at all density scales
No layout shift introduced when swapping label -> spinner -> icon; spinner should reserve space or use absolute overlay to avoid reflow
Theming fallback documented: for legacy tokens missing in private deployments, buttons degrade to high-contrast neutral with clear migration guidance
Design handoff includes Figma components, token mapping table, and a CSS usage snippet for engineering
implementation_notes: Introduce --rwd-btn-spinner-size token and tie spinner to computed font-size for density parity
Prefer absolute-position overlay spinner (opacity + transform) instead of inline content replacement to avoid layout shift; provide .btn--reserve-space utility as fallback
Add data-loading="interruptible" attribute to buttons that support cancellation; ENG should wire Esc handler to dispatch cancel event and expose onCancel in React wrapper
Use aria-busy="true" on the button and announce state changes to a persistent aria-live="polite" region for screen readers
Adjust token precedence: theme > component-overrides > legacy-tokens; include small migration shim in CSS to map old token names to new ones
Icon-only hit target: use padding defined by --rwd-btn-hitbox to maintain 44px min while keeping visual size smaller
Motion: respect reduced-motion media query; spinner crossfade duration 120ms when motion allowed
comments: 2026-02-19 - Asha: Kickoff with PM (Lina) and ENG lead (Jon). Agreed to prioritize primary/ghost contrast and interruptible loading for Q1 patch.
2026-02-24 - Diego: Prototyped absolute overlay spinner in storybook (stories/button/interruptible). Noted small jitter in RTL when overlay anchor used; flagged to QA.
2026-03-01 - UX Research (Marin): Usability test (8 participants) shows users expect an explicit cancel affordance for actions >3s; spinner-only approach leads to abandonment.
2026-03-03 - PM (Lina): Approved adding Esc keyboard cancel + visible cancel affordance. ENG to confirm API surface for cancellation events.
2026-03-05 - ENG (Jon): Implemented data-loading attribute and exposed onCancel callback in React Button. PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/ui/pull/2147
2026-03-08 - Design review: tightened focus ring thickness at compact density to avoid overlap with icon masks. Requested token name changes to be less platform-specific.

2026-03-09 - QA (Rina): Regression test found a case where disabled + loading combined shows spinner with 0.6 opacity causing contrast failure; added repro to PR and suggested approach to hide spinner when disabled.
2026-03-10 - Diego: Updated Figma with cancel CTA microcopy and added token mapping sheet. Ready for engineering rebase and a follow-up small-batch rollout.
qa_steps: Load storybook Button stories: compact/regular/dense for all variants and confirm contrast ratios using axe snapshot
Simulate long-running action: click interruptible button, verify visible cancel button appears, press Esc to cancel, ensure onCancel fired in console and aria-live message announces cancellation
Icon-only touch target verification: measure computed hitbox in browser devtools on mobile emulation (min 44px)
Disabled + loading: verify spinner hidden when aria-disabled or disabled attribute present; confirm no low-contrast spinner visible
RTL check: confirm spinner overlay anchors to the correct edge and no overflow is introduced
Theming fallback: remove theme tokens via CSS override and confirm fallback neutral style and clear console warning for missing tokens
related_prs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/987 (runtime: expose cancel route for long ops)
